newsitem.title: FRANCE: Scor confirms plans to boost dividend.
newsitem.headline: Scor confirms plans to boost dividend.

text.p: French reinsurer Scor reiterated on Friday it planned to boost its dividend for the 1996 financial year.
"Our results will be in line with our forecasts and we will propose to the board that it make an effort on the dividend," Scor's assistant managing director Francois Reach told Reuters.
He added the company was overcapitalised and that it was choosing this avenue while waiting for French legislation to authorise share buybacks.
He said the company had already said at the end of last year it planned to raise its dividend.
Scor closed up 5.04 percent at 219.0 francs, bolstered by dividend hopes, dealers said.
In September, Scor, whose first half profits jumped 40 percent, forecast a good performance for the full year. The company's second half is usually better than its first half.
For 1995, the company paid a dividend of five francs.
